description: For a theory on atoms indexed by \(\mathbb N\), the surviving binary assignments of length \(n\) form a finite set with at most \(2^n\) members.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.prefix_level_bound
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
  Nat.card { r // Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.PrefixSurvives Γ n r } ≤ 2 ^ n
